Privacy policy

This policy explains what personal data Qilich collects through qilich.com, why, who else processes it, and how you can see, correct or delete it. It applies to visitors to the site and to anyone who contacts us about a project.

Updated 21 October 2026

Who is responsible

Qilich, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. Write to inbox@qilich.com with any question about this policy.

What we collect

  • What you send us: your name, phone number or email, company and message, when you write, call or use the contact form.
  • What you type into SamurAI, our project advisor: the description of your business. It goes to our AI provider, Anthropic, to prepare the answer. We do not store it; the provider may keep it for a limited time under its own terms. Do not type personal or confidential information into it.
  • Technical data: your IP address and browser details, which our hosting provider, Cloudflare, processes to deliver the site and protect it from attacks. SamurAI counts requests per IP address for one day to limit misuse.
  • Analytics: we use no analytics or advertising cookies.
  • Settings in your browser: the site remembers your sound setting in your browser’s local storage. It never leaves your device.

Why we use it

To answer your enquiry, prepare an estimate, make and carry out a contract, prepare SamurAI’s answer and keep the site secure. We do not sell personal data and do not use it for advertising.

Legal basis

In Uzbekistan we process personal data under the Law “On Personal Data” (No. ZRU-547 of 2 July 2019): with the consent you give by sending us your details, and as far as a contract with you requires.

For people in Japan we follow Japan’s Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI): we use personal information only for the purposes on this page, keep it secure, and give it to no third party except as described here or as the law requires.

Who else processes it

Cloudflare (hosting and security), our email provider and Anthropic (the AI model behind SamurAI). Some of them process data outside Uzbekistan and Japan, mainly in the United States. The contact form asks for your consent to this before you send it, and you can withdraw it at any time.

How long we keep it

Enquiries and correspondence: while we discuss or work on your project, and then as long as accounting and contract law require. SamurAI texts are not stored. You can ask us to delete your data at any time.

Your rights

You can ask what data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, withdraw your consent, or ask us to stop using it. Write to inbox@qilich.com. In Japan these are your rights under the APPI to request disclosure, correction and suspension of use. You can also complain to the authority that oversees personal data in your country.

Changes

When the way we handle data changes, we update this page and show the date at the top.
